integrity: All displayed distribution and threshold claims are supported by explicit spherical geometry; independent scientific audit has not been performed. The initiating 2015 paper uses historical MSC2010 primary code 52A23; this finding uses the MSC2020 code 52A22 for random convex geometry and integral geometry.
scientific_limitations: The all-dimensional law covers the high-width cap regime and its first boundary correction, not the full lower tail for d>3; numerical checks supplement an analytic proof. Existing higher-moment formulas are acknowledged, and prior equivalence remains a historical risk.
title: Exact directional width law of the cube and its first spherical-cap transition
